metadata.case_name: POON CHING MAN v. LAM HOI PUN

injuries.description: depressed fracture of right lateral tibial plateau
injuries.body_part: right lateral tibial plateau / right knee
source: On 24 March 2009, the plaintiff had a private MRI which showed depressed fracture of right lateral tibial plateau and lateral meniscal tear.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of tibia, lateral condyle

injuries.body_part: right fibula head / right lower leg
source: Dr Fu Wai Kee, an orthopaedic specialist appointed jointly by the parties, made a single joint medical report dated 5 December 2011. His diagnosis was that the clinical picture of the plaintiff is compatible with fracture of right lateral tibial plateau and fibula head with lateral meniscal tear and that there is no abnormality with the left knee.
On 24 March 2009, the plaintiff had a private MRI which showed depressed fracture of right lateral tibial plateau and lateral meniscal tear.

Dr Fu Wai Kee, an orthopaedic specialist appointed jointly by the parties, made a single joint medical report dated 5 December 2011. His diagnosis was that the clinical picture of the plaintiff is compatible with fracture of right lateral tibial plateau and fibula head with lateral meniscal tear and that there is no abnormality with the left knee.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: tenderness over lateral femoral condyle and medial joint line
weakness and pain in his right knee will persist
on and off pain which will require treatment on a need to basis
difficulty performing tasks of heavy manual lifting
not able to engage in manual heavy lifting work

treatments_received: arthroscopic guided partial menisectomy of lateral meniscus
internal fixation of right lateral tibial plateau fracture
treatments_future: consideration of removal of prominent screws (surgery)

losses.description: The plaintiff is not able to engage in manual heavy lifting work. He should have no difficulty in driving and should therefore shift to light duties, eg, working as a driver without weight lifting.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Because of his disability, he can no longer enjoy his hobby of jogging and Thai boxing.

comparable_cases.case_name: Yeung Wai Ming v Tsui Ma Sing
comparable_cases.injury_description: comminuted fracture of his right patella. Open reduction and internal fixation was performed. After recovery, he complained of persistent pain and could not even drive because of it.
